skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key terms related to information systems, management information systems, system development, system analysis, physical design, logical design, system development lifecycle.
Understand and explain system analysis and design thinking; understand logical and physical design, database design, algorithm design, human-machine interaction design, hardware design.
Proficient use of tools like MS Project, Draw.io for reporting progress and drawing various diagrams such as BFD, IFD, CD, DFD, ERD during the system analysis phase.
Analyze real-world problems at enterprises to decide or advise leaders on which management information systems to apply in the enterprise that are most suitable and optimal.
Develop skills in conducting practical surveys, planning, analyzing, designing, developing, operating, and maintaining management information systems.
Ability to handle situations and issues arising during the management of information systems.
Skills to self-study and read materials about analyzing, designing, developing, operating, and maintaining information systems.
Ability to work independently or actively, effectively participate in group activities. Ability to organize group activities.
Social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information systems management.
